name: DomainDiscovery
subcategory: domain name search · availability · AI naming
tagline: Free domain search with live availability across 1,600+ TLDs, AI names, bulk checks, WHOIS, and registrar price compare

pricing.notes: Marketed as free domain search and tools with local shortlists; not a registrar. Checkout is on third-party registrars. No paid plan page found.

verdictSummary: A one-shot app can wrap RDAP/WHOIS, a simple name generator, and a local shortlist. Matching live multi-TLD coverage, bulk throughput, geo tools, and honest registrar price signals is a multi-day integration and data problem, not a single prompt.
coreLoopDIY: Accept a domain or keyword, check availability via RDAP or a free API, generate a few brandable variants, save a shortlist locally, and link out to a registrar.
requirements: RDAP or domain availability API access
optional LLM API for name ideas
whatYouLose: bulk and geo domain workflows polished for speed
privacy-first free UX with no signup
ongoing maintenance of TLD and pricing signals
moatNotes: breadth of TLD checks + price research + free privacy UX; not a registrar network
whyPeopleStillPay: They do not pay for DomainDiscovery today if the product stays free · they use it to skip slow registrar UIs and keep shortlists private. A DIY tool works until multi-TLD accuracy, bulk volume, and price compare break down.

priorArt.name: RDAP
priorArt.desc: public RDAP ecosystem for domain status

notes: Also branded DomainsDiscovery. Free domain research toolkit; registration happens at external registrars. Related surface: aidomainassistant.com.
prompt:
Build a free local domain research mini-app (Next.js or Vite + Express). Requirements:

- Search bar: check one domain + common TLDs (.com .io .ai .net .co) via RDAP or a free availability API.
- Show available / taken / unknown; never invent premium prices.
- AI name ideas: keyword → 20 brandable candidates via OpenAI/Anthropic key in .env, then check each.
- Local shortlist (localStorage or SQLite) with export CSV.
- Link out to a registrar search URL for checkout (no payments).
- README: setup, API keys, honesty about snapshot availability.

Out of scope: real multi-registrar checkout, 1600 TLDs day one, accounts.

Ship npm run dev with a working happy path.
